T-Mobile Launches $1,000 Discount Promotion for Apple's New iPhone Duo Foldable Smartphone

T-Mobile Offers Half Off Apple's First Foldable Phone

T-Mobile has introduced a promotional discount offering $1,000 off, or 50% of the purchase price, for Apple's newly released foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo. The device retails for $2,000 outright, making the promotion a substantial incentive for consumers looking to adopt Apple's first entry into the foldable market without paying the full retail cost upfront.

To qualify for the $1,000 discount, customers must sign up for a new line on T-Mobile's Experience Beyond plan. Additionally, buyers must either port in their phone number from another carrier or trade in an eligible device. The promotional savings are distributed to the customer as bill credits spread across a 36-month period. Shoppers should also account for a one-time $35 connection charge associated with the activation.

Plan Requirements and Perks

The required Experience Beyond plan is priced at $100 per month for a single line when utilizing AutoPay, excluding applicable taxes and fees. The plan includes unlimited talk, text, and 5G premium data. Subscribers also receive bundle perks such as Netflix with ads, Hulu subscriptions, access to Apple TV for an additional $3 per month, unlimited mobile hotspot data, T-Satellite access, annual phone upgrade eligibility, and a five-year price guarantee. For international use, the plan provides unlimited text and 30GB of high-speed data in Canada and Mexico, alongside unlimited text and 15GB of high-speed data across more than 215 other countries.

Device Specifications and High Demand

The iPhone Duo marks Apple's debut in the foldable smartphone category. It features a dual-display design incorporating a 5.4-inch screen when folded and a 7.6-inch screen when unfolded, which Apple designates as its thinnest iPhone profile in unfolded mode. Under the hood, the device runs on the new Apple A20 Pro processor developed on a 2-nanometer process technology, which Apple states delivers 40% greater graphics performance compared to previous generation iPhones.

Due to significant consumer interest, initial stock for the iPhone Duo has sold out. T-Mobile has indicated that shipping times are currently extended past normal windows due to high demand. However, the carrier confirmed it will honor the promotional terms, and billing cycles for the offer will not begin until the device actually ships to the buyer.

Practical Implications and Verification

For consumers evaluating this offer, several factors require consideration:

  • Confirmed Details: The $1,000 discount is delivered strictly via 36-month bill credits. The promotion requires a new line on the Experience Beyond plan ($100/mo with AutoPay) and either a number port-in or an eligible trade-in. A one-time $35 connection fee applies.
  • Unknowns & Uncertainties: Exact shipping timelines remain variable due to high demand and initial sell-outs, meaning buyers may experience extended wait times before receiving their hardware.
  • How to Verify: Readers can review the full terms, check device eligibility requirements, and examine official plan details directly through the IGN Source Article.
